question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing right winger, and Gertrude is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Finally, Fred and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right midfielder
(C) sweeper
(D) right back
(E) benchwarmer
(F) right winger
(G) center midfielder
solution:
Players, in column order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: left winger | right midfielder | sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | right winger | center midfielder
1. Dave ↔ Bob: left winger | right back | sweeper | right midfielder | benchwarmer | right winger | center midfielder
2. Claire ↔ Fred: left winger | right back | right winger | right midfielder | benchwarmer | sweeper | center midfielder
3. Dave ↔ Eve: left winger | right back | right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | sweeper | center midfielder
4. Bob ↔ Alice: right back | left winger | right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | sweeper | center midfielder
5. Claire ↔ Alice: right winger | left winger | right back | benchwarmer | right midfielder | sweeper | center midfielder
6. Eve ↔ Claire: right winger | left winger | right midfielder | benchwarmer | right back | sweeper | center midfielder
7. Fred ↔ Claire: right winger | left winger | sweeper | benchwarmer | right back | right midfielder | center midfielder
Gertrude is playing center midfielder, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
